summary: Iteration 33 (frontend only, IT) — All 4 flows PASS. FLOW A (Return Summary, demo): armed via POST /api/qa/return-summary/arm {ply_b3869932233f, 14h} → login → tap first 'Entra' (Regno 1) → return-summary-screen appeared automatically within ~4s. Verified: title 'Bentornato, Signore', return-summary-away = 'Sei stato via 14 ore', return-summary-produced with resources (5888 legno, 8693 pietra, 3084 ferro, 4037 oro, 771 gemme), all 4 stats present (return-summary-battles/-queues/-marches/-missions). Tap return-summary-open ('Vai al Regno') closed the screen and landed on the map tab. Reload → summary did NOT reappear. GET /api/worlds/world_1/me returned player.return_pending=false. Opened /return-summary manually while not armed → return-summary-quiet + return-summary-open button visible, no crash. FLOW B (skins unlocked, demo, prestige 3686+): /house shows house-march-skin-panel with all 4 cards and preview. Each *-req reads 'Sbloccata' (falcon/elephant/dragon). Tap house-march-skin-falcon → PUT succeeded, banner 'Salvato' shown, preview label 'Anteprima 3D · Falco'. Then tap house-march-skin-dragon → preview label 'Anteprima 3D · Drago' — dragon restored. FLOW C (skins locked, fresh account qa-e-04f1cb@example.com, house CasaE04f1cb, world_1, prestige 0): joined via 'Fonda la tua Casata' modal + 'Conferma'. /house shows classic unlocked; falcon-req='Prestigio 500 (0) · oppure possiedi Falco', elephant-req='Prestigio 2000 (0) · oppure possiedi Elefante da Guerra', dragon-req='Prestigio 5000 (0) · oppure possiedi Drago'. Locked cards render at reduced opacity (0.55, no aria-disabled attr — Pressable disabled only during mutation). Tap locked falcon → preview label changed to 'Falco' only (no error toast). GET /api/worlds/world_1/house confirmed house.march_skin='classic', march_skin_unlocks={classic:true, falcon:false, elephant:false, dragon:false}. Then POST /api/qa/prestige {ply_1cde503b04d7, 600} → 200 OK. GET again: unlocks.falcon=true. Reload /house → falcon-req='Sbloccata' (elephant/dragon still show 'Prestigio X (600)'). Tap falcon → 'Salvato' banner, preview label 'Anteprima 3D · Falco'. Inbox tab shows notification 'Skin marcia sbloccata — Premio Prestigio 500: la skin marcia «Falco» è tua. Attivala nella Casata.' (event MARCH_SKIN_UNLOCKED, deep_link=house). FLOW D (regressions): 0 red JS errors during login+return-summary+house+inbox flows (only 1 transient console error 'Failed to load resource: 502' — non-blocking, unrelated). /battles endpoint polling counter = 0 requests in ~9s while viewing the map tab with Unicorn NOT in flight (correct). Daily gate appeared only AFTER the Return Summary was dismissed and only on the reload run (as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: house.tsx line 189: `const unlocked = q.data?.march_skin_unlocks?.[sk.key] ?? sk.requires_unit === null;` — correct: server-side unlocks are the source of truth, with fallback to sk.requires_unit===null for classic. Verified end-to-end that a fresh account with prestige=0 sees {falcon:false, elephant:false, dragon:false} and after +600 prestige only falcon flips to true.

house.tsx line 195-203: Pressable onPress always calls `setPreviewSkin(sk.key)` before checking unlocked/selected, so locked cards correctly show a preview-only interaction (verified: preview label changed to 'Falco' with 0 prestige, no PUT was fired, no toast). Consider dimming the card cursor to `not-allowed` on web for extra affordance, but not required.

ReturnGate.tsx line 22: gating conditions (worldId, player.return_pending, intro_seen, tour_seen, !tourActive, !cinematic.active, shownFor !== worldId) all met on demo login → single push to /return-summary observed. `shownFor` module-level guard correctly prevents re-open after reload within the same session (verified: after dismiss+reload the summary did not reappear).

return-summary.tsx line 52-56: `close()` calls seen.mutate() (clears return_pending server-side) then router.back() or replace('/(tabs)/map'). Confirmed via GET /api/worlds/world_1/me that player.return_pending flipped to false after tapping return-summary-open.

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 flows PASS (A Return Summary, B skins unlocked, C skins locked + prestige unlock + inbox MARCH_SKIN_UNLOCKED, D no regressions)
